title: ticketing.bookingAvailability
description: Availability update sent by a ticket sales provider for one of its registered reservation links.

identifier.description: Identifies the registration at the ticket sales provider, as `<provider>:<account>:<event>`: the name of the provider, the account of the organiser at the provider, and the event within that account.

allOf.description: URL of an external page where interested attendees can register for a waiting list. Optional.
